name: VeraCrypt Startup Mount
changes_cs: Aktualizovana integrace VC na aktualni skin-aware WDUi konstrukci a opraven release wrapper pro UI Automation a vizualizacni/media moduly; odstraneny zbyvajici legacy selection, chrome, popup, click a command wrappers; setup je sestaven z aktualniho CPM/WDUi zakladu.
changes_en: Updated VC integration to the current skin-aware WDUi construction and fixed the release wrapper for the UI Automation and visualization/media modules; removed the remaining legacy selection, chrome, popup, click, and command wrappers; the setup is built from the current CPM/WDUi baseline.

history.changes_cs: Aktualizovana integrace VC na aktualni skin-aware WDUi konstrukci a opraven release wrapper pro UI Automation a vizualizacni/media moduly; odstraneny zbyvajici legacy selection, chrome, popup, click a command wrappers; setup je sestaven z aktualniho CPM/WDUi zakladu.
history.changes_en: Updated VC integration to the current skin-aware WDUi construction and fixed the release wrapper for the UI Automation and visualization/media modules; removed the remaining legacy selection, chrome, popup, click, and command wrappers; the setup is built from the current CPM/WDUi baseline.

history.changes_cs: Pribaluje novy WDUi skin Neon Rose Black do VeraCrypt Startup Mount manageru a setupu; skin katalog v instalaci ma 51 presetu vcetne neon-rose-black.
history.changes_en: Packages the new WDUi Neon Rose Black skin into the VeraCrypt Startup Mount manager and setup; the installed skin catalog now has 51 presets including neon-rose-black.

history.changes_cs: Doplňuje verzi přímo do titulku manageru za název aplikace podle Jarvis/WDUi standardu, aby bylo v hlavičce hned vidět, jaká build verze běží.
history.changes_en: Adds the version directly to the manager title after the app name, matching the Jarvis/WDUi titlebar standard so the running build is visible immediately.

history.changes_cs: Doplňuje spodní odsazení preference panelu manageru a posouvá footer akce níž, aby volba výkonu UI, autostart a tlačítko Uložit nepůsobily nalepeně na spodní hranu.
history.changes_en: Adds bottom breathing room to the manager preferences panel and moves footer actions down so UI performance, autostart, and Save no longer feel tight against the lower edge.

history.changes_cs: Dolaďuje svislé i vodorovné rozestupy v manageru, aby řada tlačítek mapování nebyla nalepená na okraj panelu a dlouhé akce nebyly zkrácené ve výraznějších skinech.
history.changes_en: Polishes vertical and horizontal spacing in the manager so the mapping action button row no longer sits tight against the panel edge and long action labels are not clipped in stronger skins.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje překryv ovládacích prvků v manageru a drží horní a spodní panel zarovnané i při menší uložené výšce okna.
history.changes_en: Fixes overlapping controls in the manager and keeps the upper and lower panels aligned when a smaller saved window height is restored.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno zobrazeni standardniho Windows hover tooltipu tray ikony: VC ted pri NOTIFYICON_VERSION_4 nastavuje NIF_SHOWTIP, aby se popis nad ikonou opravdu ukazal.
history.changes_en: Fixed the standard Windows tray icon hover tooltip display: VC now sets NIF_SHOWTIP with NOTIFYICON_VERSION_4 so the icon description is actually shown.

history.changes_cs: Tray hover tooltip ted ukazuje identitu appky, aktualni stav nebo dostupny update, souhrn mapovani a klik hint bez lokalnich cest. Tray ikona se po restartu Exploreru obnovi vcetne tooltipu.
history.changes_en: The tray hover tooltip now shows the app identity, current state or available update, mapping summary, and click hint without local paths. The tray icon is restored after Explorer restarts, including the current tooltip.

history.changes_cs: Update ikona je ukotvena v titulku, vychozi velikost manageru je 2/3 pracovni plochy a reset velikosti ji obnovi vcetne ulozeni UI stavu.
history.changes_en: Pins the update icon in the titlebar, sets the manager default size to two thirds of the work area, and makes reset restore and persist that size.

history.changes_cs: Pridan perzistentni WDUi vykonovy profil a pritvrzen no-cache update manifest/payload fetch.
history.changes_en: Added the persistent WDUi performance profile setting and hardened no-cache update manifest/payload fetches.

history.changes_cs: Pridan perzistentni WDUi vykonovy profil v manageru a lokalni konfiguraci.
history.changes_en: Added a persistent WDUi performance profile setting in the manager and local config.

history.changes_cs: Doplnene lokalizovane owner-facing chybove, About a update dialog texty; startup zustava tray-only a clean uninstall/reinstall je zachovany.
history.changes_en: Added localized owner-facing error, About, and update dialog text; startup remains tray-only and clean uninstall/reinstall support is preserved.

history.changes_cs: Lokalizovane owner-facing chybove dialogy pro mapovani, mount, autostart a heslo; tray-only/startup uninstall opravy zustavaji soucasti verze.
history.changes_en: Localized owner-facing error dialogs for mappings, mount, autostart, and password handling; tray-only startup and clean uninstall fixes remain included.

history.changes_cs: Opraven čistý uninstall: MSI odinstalace po sobě uklidí setup wrapper, HKLM registrace a shortcuty; uninstall z nainstalovaného setupu se bezpečně předá do dočasného workeru, aby šlo smazat i samotný setup EXE.
history.changes_en: Fixed clean uninstall: MSI uninstall now removes the setup wrapper, HKLM registrations, and shortcuts; uninstall launched from the installed setup is brokered through a temporary worker so the setup EXE itself can be deleted.

history.changes_cs: Přidán nedestruktivní self-test diagnostiky mountu: chybějící heslo, chybějící volume, duplicitní drive letter, selhání spuštění procesu a kontrola, že se heslo nepropíše do logu.
history.changes_en: Added a non-destructive mount diagnostics self-test covering missing password, missing volume, duplicate drive letters, process launch failure codes, and password non-leakage in logs.

history.changes_cs: Opraven embedded-MSI install: setup po instalaci synchronizuje setup wrapper do Program Files, znovu opravi autostart registraci na --mount --quiet --tray a restart appky vede pres Explorer, aby manager nebezel elevated.
history.changes_en: Fixed embedded-MSI install: setup now synchronizes the setup wrapper into Program Files, repairs autostart registration to --mount --quiet --tray, and restarts the app through Explorer so the manager does not keep running elevated.

history.changes_cs: Pridan tray-only startup self-test a cache-bust pro update manifest i stahovane payloady, aby startovni/update overeni nevidelo zastarale GitHub raw soubory.
history.changes_en: Added the tray-only startup self-test and cache-busting for the update manifest and downloaded payloads so startup/update verification does not see stale GitHub raw files.

history.changes_cs: Pridan tray-only startup self-test: novy build overuje, ze start pres --mount --quiet --tray zustane jen v oznamovaci oblasti a neotevre manager.
history.changes_en: Added a tray-only startup self-test: the new build verifies that --mount --quiet --tray stays in the notification area and does not open the manager.

history.changes_cs: Doplneny update self-testy, live kontrola manifestu a srovnane VS18 build prostredi pro VC overeni.
history.changes_en: Added update self-tests, live manifest verification, and aligned the VC build environment with VS18.

history.changes_cs: Po startu Windows se appka spusti jen do tray, tise provede mount a neotevre manager.
history.changes_en: After Windows startup, the app starts in the tray only, performs the mount quietly, and does not open the manager window.

history.changes_cs: Stabilizovaná poloha rozbalovacích seznamů ve tvarovaných skinech: dropdown používá stejný virtuální layout anchor při prvním vykreslení i v externím popup okně, takže Ultraviolet Rift už nepřeskakuje mezi dvěma polohami.
history.changes_en: Stabilized dropdown placement in shaped skins: dropdowns now use the same virtual layout anchor for the first inline frame and the external popup window, preventing Ultraviolet Rift from jumping between two nearby positions.

history.changes_cs: Historický věcný changelog pro tuto verzi se v dostupném archivu nedochoval. Konkrétní funkční změnu proto bezpečně netvrdíme; záznam označuje pouze ověřené technické vydání aktualizace.
history.changes_en: The factual changelog for this historical version was not preserved in the available archive. No specific feature is claimed; the record only identifies a verified technical update publication.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno blikani dropdownu a item tooltipu u tvarovanych skinu, hlavne Ultraviolet Rift: WDUi uz pri stejne geometrii zbytecne neprepozicovava transient okna a dropdown tooltip je pruchodny pro mys.
history.changes_en: Fixed dropdown and item tooltip flicker in shaped skins, especially Ultraviolet Rift: WDUi no longer repositions transient windows when geometry is unchanged, and dropdown item tooltips are mouse-transparent.

history.changes_cs: Stabilizovano kotveni dropdownu u tvarovanych skinu: externi popup okno se nyni kotvi podle stabilniho virtualniho layoutu selectboxu, takze u Ultraviolet Rift nemeni polohu mezi dvema blizkymi pozicemi.
history.changes_en: Stabilized dropdown anchoring for shaped skins: external popup windows now anchor to the selectbox stable virtual layout, so Ultraviolet Rift no longer shifts between two nearby positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno jemne poskakovani dropdownu u skinu Ultraviolet Rift: externi dropdown se nyni kotvi podle stejneho paint-kompatibilniho vizualniho rectu jako samotny selectbox.
history.changes_en: Fixed subtle dropdown position jitter in the Ultraviolet Rift skin: external dropdowns now anchor to the same paint-compatible visual rect as the selectbox itself.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno jemne poskakovani dropdownu u skinu Ultraviolet Rift: externi dropdown se nyni kotvi podle stejneho paint-kompatibilniho vizualniho rectu jako samotny selectbox.
history.changes_en: Fixed subtle dropdown position jitter in the Ultraviolet Rift skin: external dropdowns now anchor to the same paint-compatible visual rect as the selectbox itself.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno kotveni WDUi dropdownu v tvarovanych skinech: externi popup se ted pri otevreni ukotvi k viditelne contour-follow pozici selectboxu a zustane zamceny, takze Ultraviolet Rift nema jemne preskakovat mezi dvema polohami.
history.changes_en: Fixed WDUi dropdown anchoring in shaped skins: the external popup now anchors to the visible contour-follow position of the select box when opened and stays locked there, so Ultraviolet Rift should no longer subtly jump between two positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno stabilni chovani WDUi selectboxu v tvarovanych skinech: dropdown, hit-test a zavirani dropdownu ted pouzivaji stejne contour-follow bounds, takze Ultraviolet Rift uz nema jemne prepinat polohu comboboxu mezi dvema parpixelovymi stavy.
history.changes_en: Fixed stable WDUi selectbox behavior in shaped skins: dropdown placement, hit-testing, and dropdown dismissal now use the same contour-follow bounds, so Ultraviolet Rift should no longer subtly switch combo boxes between two positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno stabilni chovani WDUi selectboxu v tvarovanych skinech: dropdown, hit-test a dismiss logika ted pouzivaji stejne contour-follow bounds, takze Ultraviolet Rift uz nema prepinat polohu comboboxu mezi dvema parpixelovymi stavy.
history.changes_en: Fixed stable WDUi selectbox behavior in shaped skins: dropdown, hit-testing, and dismiss logic now use the same contour-follow bounds, so Ultraviolet Rift should no longer switch the combo box between two slightly shifted positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno jemne poskakovani WDUi dropdownu ve tvarovanych skinech: polozky comboboxu pouzivaji stabilni viewport lane, takze text a hover radky v Ultraviolet Riftu necukaji mezi dvema polohami.
history.changes_en: Fixed subtle WDUi dropdown jitter in shaped skins: combobox items now use a stable viewport lane so text and hover rows in Ultraviolet Rift no longer jump between two positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno stabilni kotveni WDUi dropdownu v hierarchii tvarovanych panelu: externi selectbox popup ted pouziva cisty virtualni layout origin pres celou parent chain, takze skin a jazyk ve skinu Ultraviolet Rift nemaji poskakovat mezi dvema polohami.
history.changes_en: Fixed stable WDUi dropdown anchoring through shaped-panel hierarchies: external select box popups now use the pure virtual layout origin across the full parent chain, so skin and language dropdowns in the Ultraviolet Rift skin should no longer jump between two positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno ukotveni dropdownu ve tvarovanych skinech: jazykovy a skinovy seznam ve skinu Ultraviolet Rift uz nema preskakovat mezi dvema polohami o nekolik pixelu.
history.changes_en: Fixed dropdown anchoring in shaped skins: the language and skin lists in the Ultraviolet Rift skin should no longer jump between two positions by a few pixels.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno kotveni WDUi dropdownu pro konturovane selectboxy: popup se pri otevreni ukotvi k viditelne pozici controlu a uz neosciluje mezi virtualni a skinovou pozici.
history.changes_en: Fixed WDUi dropdown anchoring for contoured select boxes: the popup now anchors to the visible control position when opened and no longer oscillates between virtual and skinned positions.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno jemne poskakovani WDUi dropdownu u skinu Ultraviolet Rift: otevreny selectbox si drzi stabilni screen rect a pri hoveru, tooltipech a prubeznem prekreslovani se uz nepreanchoruje mezi dvema polohami.
history.changes_en: Fixed subtle WDUi dropdown position jitter in the Ultraviolet Rift skin: an open selectbox now keeps a stable screen rectangle and no longer re-anchors between two positions during hover, tooltip, or repaint updates.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno blikání dropdownu u skinu Ultraviolet Rift: otevřený externí dropdown už nepotkává běžný tooltip selectboxu, takže jazykový i skinový výběr zůstává vizuálně stabilní.
history.changes_en: Fixed Ultraviolet Rift dropdown flicker: an open external select dropdown now suppresses the normal selectbox tooltip, so language and skin dropdowns stay visually stable.
